name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should ship a 4px solid focus ring with a 2px outer offset, colored #005FCC, because it provides a clear visual indicator for keyboard navigation while minimizing visual noise. This decision prioritizes accessibility for keyboard users over a more pronounced focus ring, which could be distracting for mouse users. By accepting a slightly smaller focus ring, we trade off some visibility for a more balanced visual design. This compromise ensures that EXCAVA remains usable for everyone, including those who rely on keyboard navigation.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px ring with 2px offset still risks failing 4.5:1 contrast on dark backgrounds (#121212), especially when paired with patterned or busy UI. Better alternative: 3px ring with 3px offset in #007AFF (Apple blue) meets WCAG 2.1 AA on both light and dark modes. Settle by testing both against WCAG contrast checker at 125% zoom.
